title: Purchase Order

headings.text: General Terms and Conditions of Purchase

key_sentences: Please quote the purchase order number on all delivery notes and invoices.
Deliveries are accepted Monday to Friday between 08:00 and 15:00; call the stores supervisor on 01632 960 291 to book a slot.
This order is subject to the General Terms and Conditions of Purchase overleaf.
No terms proposed by the Supplier shall apply unless agreed in writing by the Authority’s procurement manager.
Time of delivery is of the essence.
The Authority may cancel all or part of the order by written notice if the Supplier fails to perform any of its obligations.
These conditions are governed by the law of England and Wales.
